cas: 42542-10-9: MDMA, racemic (NIST, read twice); the EUDA profile prints this number as '42542-10-09' (read twice), a misprint: the last part of a CAS number is a single check digit

forms.detail: EUDA: white tablets with a characteristic impression (logo). DEA lists pills and tablets; AIHW: often in the form of a tablet or capsules (Australia).
EUDA: the hydrochloride (CAS 64057-70-1) is a white or off-white powder or crystals soluble in water; DEA lists powder and crystal; AIHW: can also be in powder or crystal form.
EUDA: less commonly as white powders or capsules; DEA lists gel capsules ('Molly').
EUDA: a colourless oil, insoluble in water.
Listed among forms by DEA (no description given).
EUDA names MDA (methylenedioxyamphetamine), MDEA (methylenedioxyethylamphetamine) and MBDB (N-methyl-1-(1,3-benzodioxol-5-yl)-2-butanamine) alongside MDMA.
